selection_rule.objective: maximise recall within the alarm budget
selection_rule.rationale: Highest recall among thresholds holding precision >= 0.80, false-positive rate <= 0.20 and accuracy >= 0.8750.

source.important_note: This threshold was selected on a validation subset CARVED FROM TRAIN (validation_fraction=0.15), never on the 394-clip primary/evaluation set. This is what makes it the 'clean' baseline as opposed to Experiment 1's threshold=0.14, which was selected on the same 394 clips used for reporting (optimistically biased, see docs/temporal_baseline_results.md caveat).
